import sys
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax

# Inline the FourierForecasterLN model with needs_rng attribute
class FourierForecasterLN(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int = 320
    proj_rank: int = 32

    # CRITICAL: Tell the training system this model needs RNG for dropout
    needs_rng = True

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training=False):
        # x shape: (batch, 4, 71721)
        batch_size, seq_len, n_neurons = x.shape

        # Project down to lower rank
        h = nn.Dense(self.proj_rank, name='proj_down')(x)  # (batch, 4, proj_rank)

        # FFT in the time dimension
        h_freq = jnp.fft.rfft(h, axis=1)  # (batch, freq_bins, proj_rank)

        # Process in frequency domain with rank_k
        h_real = jnp.real(h_freq)
        h_imag = jnp.imag(h_freq)
        h_concat = jnp.concatenate([h_real, h_imag], axis=-1)

        h = nn.Dense(self.rank_k, name='freq_dense1')(h_concat)
        h = nn.LayerNorm(name='ln1')(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)

        h = nn.Dense(self.rank_k, name='freq_dense2')(h)
        h = nn.LayerNorm(name='ln2')(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)

        # Back to complex
        h_real = h[..., :self.proj_rank]
        h_imag = h[..., self.proj_rank:]
        h_freq_out = h_real + 1j * h_imag

        # Pad for IFFT to output length (32)
        target_len = 32
        freq_bins = h_freq_out.shape[1]
        if freq_bins < (target_len // 2 + 1):
            padding = jnp.zeros((batch_size, target_len // 2 + 1 - freq_bins, self.proj_rank), dtype=h_freq_out.dtype)
            h_freq_out = jnp.concatenate([h_freq_out, padding], axis=1)

        # IFFT back to time domain
        h = jnp.fft.irfft(h_freq_out, n=target_len, axis=1)  # (batch, 32, proj_rank)

        # Project back to full dimensionality
        output = nn.Dense(n_neurons, name='proj_up')(h)  # (batch, 32, 71721)

        return output

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

def create_network(hparams):
    model = FourierForecasterLN(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
    return model

def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    # Curvature penalty from the SOTA submission
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate)
    )

import sys
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax

# Inline the FourierForecasterLN model with needs_rng attribute
class FourierForecasterLN(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int = 320
    proj_rank: int = 32

    # CRITICAL: Tell the training system this model needs RNG for dropout
    needs_rng = True

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training=False):
        # x shape: (batch, 4, 71721)
        batch_size, seq_len, n_neurons = x.shape

        # Project down to lower rank
        h = nn.Dense(self.proj_rank, name='proj_down')(x)  # (batch, 4, proj_rank)

        # FFT in the time dimension
        h_freq = jnp.fft.rfft(h, axis=1)  # (batch, freq_bins, proj_rank)

        # Process in frequency domain with rank_k
        h_real = jnp.real(h_freq)
        h_imag = jnp.imag(h_freq)
        h_concat = jnp.concatenate([h_real, h_imag], axis=-1)

        h = nn.Dense(self.rank_k, name='freq_dense1')(h_concat)
        h = nn.LayerNorm(name='ln1')(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)

        h = nn.Dense(self.rank_k, name='freq_dense2')(h)
        h = nn.LayerNorm(name='ln2')(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)

        # Project to 2*proj_rank for real and imaginary parts
        h = nn.Dense(2 * self.proj_rank, name='to_complex')(h)

        # Back to complex
        h_real = h[..., :self.proj_rank]
        h_imag = h[..., self.proj_rank:]
        h_freq_out = h_real + 1j * h_imag

        # Pad for IFFT to output length (32)
        target_len = 32
        freq_bins = h_freq_out.shape[1]
        if freq_bins < (target_len // 2 + 1):
            padding = jnp.zeros((batch_size, target_len // 2 + 1 - freq_bins, self.proj_rank), dtype=h_freq_out.dtype)
            h_freq_out = jnp.concatenate([h_freq_out, padding], axis=1)

        # IFFT back to time domain
        h = jnp.fft.irfft(h_freq_out, n=target_len, axis=1)  # (batch, 32, proj_rank)

        # Project back to full dimensionality
        output = nn.Dense(n_neurons, name='proj_up')(h)  # (batch, 32, 71721)

        return output

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

def create_network(hparams):
    model = FourierForecasterLN(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
    return model

def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    # Curvature penalty from the SOTA submission
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate)
    )
